source: SDSS DR16Q quasar catalogue (Lyke et al. 2020, ApJS 250, 8; 2020ApJS..250....8L)
magnitudeNote: i-band PSFMAG as catalogued (SDSS asinh-style magnitudes are not corrected or converted); null when absent
ordering: chunks are sorted by (5-degree declination band, RA, original row); unplaced records form band 99

sentinelNotes.IS_QSO_FINAL: values of 0 or less denote non-quasars (superset only; the quasar-only file contains selected quasars)
sentinelNotes.Z_VI: -999 = possible blazar, no meaningful redshift from an emission feature; -1 = not visually inspected
sentinelNotes.Z_CONF: -1 = not visually inspected; 0 = inspected but no confident redshift or classification
sentinelNotes.BAL_PROB: -1 = redshift too low for a detection within the spectroscopic wavelength range
sentinelNotes.QN_*: -1 = not processed by QuasarNET (column-specific; check the data model)
sentinelNotes.GALEX_MATCHED / UKIDSS_MATCHED / FIRST_M: 1 = found in that catalogue, 0 = not found
sentinelNotes.UNWISE flux: -1 in both bands for the 1001 quasars not identified with SDSS imaging
sentinelNotes.DLA parameters: -1 in the first element = outside the redshift range for DLA systems; all -1 = no DLA detected

citation: Lyke, B. W. et al. 2020, The Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 250, 8 (2020ApJS..250....8L). Data: SDSS. See https://www.sdss4.org/dr16/algorithms/qso_catalog/
